live_checks.details: User submitted creation, all four funding approvals, early release, and merge. Browser displayed Released; independent RPC read confirmed state 3 and funded/released events. Activity decrypted the released amount as +0.1 USDC. After merge the overview displayed confirmed status, Account ready, 100.0 USDC spendable and 0.0 incoming. This live test used one wallet as depositor and recipient; it does not establish distinct-party claim, arbitration, or timeout behavior.
